title: Microsoft Viva: targeted audience surveys in the Copilot Dashboard
summary: The briefing's rollout, default state, licensing basis and controls are supported, including the survey-data eligibility statement on the updated dashboard page. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting licensing documentation, complete the policy-creation route and identify checklist controls omitted from the table.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft is introducing a way to launch Viva Pulse surveys from the Copilot Dashboard without maintaining recipient lists.
claims.quote: We're introducing targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard. This feature enables authorized users to launch Microsoft Viva Pulse surveys for predefined Copilot user populations without creating or maintaining recipient lists.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope: Who receives; rationale: impact
claims.claim: An available survey audience is all licensed Copilot users.
claims.quote: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope: Who receives; rationale: impact
claims.claim: An available survey audience is all active Copilot users.
claims.quote: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users.

claims.claim: Survey audiences update automatically using Viva Insights data.
claims.quote: Audiences update automatically using Insights data

claims.quote: respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Targeted audience surveys are on by default for eligible organisations.
claims.quote: Targeted audience surveys are turned on by default for eligible tenants.

claims.claim: The Viva Pulse admin controls targeted audience surveys through Viva feature access management.
claims.quote: This feature is on by default and is controlled by your Viva Pulse admin through Viva feature access management.

claims.claim: The feature's licensing model is included in an existing qualifying product subscription.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (As part of this subscription, Viva Pulse survey results for the Copilot impact template are automatically shared to the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard).

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft documents full Viva Pulse functionality for users with a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Users with a Microsoft Copilot license have access to the full functionality of Viva Pulse to gather real-time feedback from their teams.
claims.fix: After this sentence, add: 'Microsoft documentation differs: the general Viva Pulse licensing requirements page lists Viva Suite, Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback, Viva Glint and the Viva Pulse Admin-led Trial for the full premium experience, but does not list Microsoft Copilot.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/pulse/get-started/licensing-requirements.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Dashboard integration requires Viva Suite, Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback, Viva Glint or Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: To integrate Pulse survey results into the Copilot Dashboard, you must have at least one of the following subscription licenses: Viva Suite; Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback; Viva Glint; Microsoft Copilot

claims.claim: Under the Microsoft Copilot subscription, results for the Copilot impact template are automatically shared to the dashboard.
claims.quote: As part of this subscription, Viva Pulse survey results for the Copilot impact template are automatically shared to the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate price or meter for targeted audience surveys is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Pulse targeted audience surveys price meter licensing FeatureId'; 'Microsoft Viva Pulse targeted audience survey separate pricing billing meter'. Opened Pulse licensing requirements, granular access controls and Measure Microsoft Copilot impact with Viva Pulse; no separate meter found.

claims.claim: The policy-creation route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote: Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy. Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off
claims.fix: The path stops at policy creation. Extend it to 'Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Pulse > Targeted Audience Surveys > Access setting > Off'. In the note, specify selecting the Viva Pulse app and Targeted Audience Surveys feature during policy creation, and applying access settings to Everyone, following https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaPulse -FeatureId <FeatureId> -Name <PolicyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy.
claims.quote: Pulse | VivaPulse ... Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false -GroupIds group1@contoso.com,group2@contoso.com -UserIds user1@contoso.com,user2@contoso.com ... use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaPulse can discover the feature identifiers for Viva Pulse access policies.
claims.quote: Pulse | VivaPulse ... Use the Get-VivaModuleFeature PowerShell cmdlet to get a list of all of the features available in a specific Microsoft 365 app and their associated IDs.

claims.claim: The documentation checked does not give the specific FeatureId for Targeted Audience Surveys.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Pulse Targeted Audience Surveys FeatureId'. Opened granular-access-controls, feature-access-management, manage-access-policies and Get-VivaModuleFeature; the Targeted Audience Surveys section gives no FeatureId.

claims.claim: The pre-built audience access control can be applied at tenant scope.
claims.quote: For all of the features below, admins can use centralized feature access management to determine access at the tenant level

claims.claim: The minimum-recipient control is in Viva Pulse under Manage > Privacy > Minimum number of recipients and responses > Minimum recipients.
claims.quote: In the Manage tab, go to the Privacy tab. Under the Minimum number of recipients and responses heading go to the Minimum recipients section

claims.claim: The organisation's minimum-recipient setting is managed by the Viva Pulse admin.
claims.quote: The Viva Pulse in-app experience can be managed by users with the Viva Pulse admin role. ... As an admin, you can set privacy options for your organization. This includes setting the minimum number of recipients required to send a pulse

claims.claim: The minimum-recipient setting cannot be set below 3.
claims.quote: The minimum value allowed is 3

claims.claim: The minimum-recipient setting cannot be set above 25.
claims.quote: maximum value allowed is 25

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Pulse minimum-recipient setting.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Pulse minimum recipients API Microsoft Graph settings endpoint'; 'Viva Pulse minimum recipients PowerShell cmdlet privacy setting'. Opened in-app Pulse setup and manage-access-policies; results document the UI, not an API for this setting.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn marks pre-built audience groups as Public Preview.
claims.quote: Pre-built audience groups are available in Public Preview.

claims.claim: Viva Insights builds the audience from filters applied on the Readiness, Adoption or Impact tab.
claims.quote: Viva Insights builds the audience based on the filters you apply to the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard ... Select the Readiness, Adoption, or Impact tab, and apply any filters you want the survey audience selection to follow.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Scope: Eligibility
claims.claim: Microsoft's notice identifies organisations with 50 or more Copilot licences as affected.
